title: Utilities
summary: Spacing, gap, padding, and visibility helpers.
body:
Spacing, gap, padding, and visibility helpers. Spacing And Visibility Utilities inc-u-stack-sm Use the utility layer when you need a light spacing or visibility adjustment without pulling in Bootstrap utility classes. Secondary Primary This alert uses inc-u-hidden-mobile and disappears on smaller screens. Common helpers now include stack spacing, gap, padding, hidden/mobile-hidden/desktop-hidden, and visually hidden text.
inc-u-stack-sm

Light spacing without Bootstrap utilities.

Hidden on smaller screens.

```html
Light spacing without Bootstrap utilities.

```
